question: What is the meaning of life cycle assessment (lca) in relation to chemical?
description:
Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) is an analytical methodology used to analyze and quantify the environmental aspects and impacts of product systems, such as materials, products, processes, buildings, over their life cycle. In relation to chemicals, LCA can help identify and assess the eco-toxicological impacts of chemicals used in various processes. However, due to the lack of broad consensus and harmonization in the LCA community, there is no clear guidance on how to achieve this in practice, and many LCA practitioners exclude toxicity-related impacts. Currently, there is an ongoing debate within standardization committees on how to include toxicity-related impacts in LCA calculations. <|ENDINPUT>
